The Midway Legacy Knife – Sky Silver is not just a tool — it’s a wearable expression of craftsmanship, legacy, and light.

watches.name: Archimèdes - World Timer - Blue Odyssey
watches.description: .product-details { font-family: inherit; margin-top: 2rem; } .product-details-intro { font-size: 1rem; margin-bottom: 1.5rem; color: #333; } details { margin-bottom: 1rem; border: 1px solid #ddd; border-radius: 8px; background: #ffffff; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; } summary { font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.05rem; cursor: pointer; list-style: none; display: flex; align-items: center; } summary::before { content: '▸'; display: inline-block; margin-right: 0.5rem; transition: transform 0.2s ease; } details[open] summary::before { content: '▾'; } summary:hover { color: #003366; } details p { margin-top: 0.5rem; line-height: 1.6; } The Archimèdes Worldtimer – Blue Odyssey is more than a watch. It’s a tool for navigating time and sea. Discover its standout features below: The Watch – A timepiece for the modern-day explorer The Archimèdes Worldtimer – Blue Odyssey blends sophistication and functionality in a 41mm 316L stainless steel case, inspired by iconic vintage dive watches. Water-resistant to 300 meters and topped with a domed sapphire crystal, it is powered by the Swiss automatic ETA 2892-A2 Top Grade movement – a reliable companion for those navigating both land and sea. Worldtimer Function – The whole world at a glance The inner bezel features 24 time zones, allowing you to keep track of global time effortlessly. Simply align your local time with the central 24-hour hand to instantly read the time around the world. A practical and elegant solution for frequent travelers and global professionals. Diver Function – Elegance meets deep-sea performance Inspired by the legendary Super Compressor design of the 1970s, this modern diver’s watch features an internal unidirectional diving bezel, operated via the 2 o’clock crown. The green triangle markers allow you to measure elapsed dive time (2 triangles = 5 minutes). A discreet helium escape valve at 9 o’clock ensures safety during deep dives. Bracelet – Three styles, one freedom Choose between the bold and solid AQUASTEEL metal bracelet , equipped with the exclusive Milus Safe Release system, the classic blue Tropic rubber strap , or the refined blue textile strap – both featuring a convenient quick-release system. Three looks, one watch – no tools required.

Encased in premium 316L stainless steel, this watch is designed to withstand the elements while maintaining a sophisticated, timeless appeal. Its ETA 2892A2 Top Grade movement is protected in a 41mm steel case, resistant up to 30 ATM or 300 meters equipped with a discreet helium valve and a bi-directional inner diver bezel. The case alternates brushed surfaces and polished accents topped by a highly domed sapphire crystal that reinforces the vintage appeal. The luminescent hands and markers provide excellent visibility in all lighting conditions. Equipped with the innovative Milus Safe Release system , the Aqua Steel bracelet allows for quick and effortless changes, adapting seamlessly to your evolving style. The ergonomic design ensures a comfortable fit, with a secure butterfly clasp adding an extra layer of security.

The three-hour digits at the cardinal points, 3 o’clock date window, and famous “Broad Arrow” hands coated in SuperLuminova combine seamlessly to bolster readability. Its ETA 2892A2 Top Grade movement is protected in a 41mm steel case, resistant up to 30 ATM or 300 meters. YELLOW STONE Just as Yellowstone's geological marvels captivate travelers from around the globe, the Archimèdes - Yellow Stone captivates watch enthusiasts with its dynamic yellow dial and unwavering precision. The name "Yellow Stone" was carefully chosen to evoke a sense of wonder, adventure, and the perpetual flow of time, all qualities that embody the spirit of this remarkable timepiece.

watches.name: Snow Star - Dark Matter
watches.description: The Snow Star uses one of the most resistant steels, 904L, to assert its toughness. The new ADLC coating makes it even more resistant in extreme environments thanks to its hardness and scratch resistance. The sunray brushed black dial traces the path of “Dauphine” hour hands over hand-laid indexes. The elongated case blends seamlessly into harmonious contours. The choice of a leather-lined strap leaves the spotlight for the Snow Star itself. A brilliant stroke of red to the 3 o’clock date counter sharpens its character. The ETA 2892 movement, a watchmaker’s jewel , gives the watch an ultimate sense of nobility . AESTHETICS & PERFORMANCE The Dark Matter microblasted ADLC case stands out both for its aesthetics and its functionality. The amorphous diamond-like carbon coating more robust than standard DLC, offers extraordinary durability, corrosion, and scratch resistance. The Dark Matter Snow Star combines a black case, a black sun-brushed dial, and a black calf leather strap for a truly monochrome look.

watches.name: Snow Star - Boreal Green
watches.description: The robust 904L steel casing gleams with its mirror polished finishing. The sunray brushed green dial traces the path of “Dauphine” hour hands over hand-laid indexes. The elongated case blends seamlessly into harmonious contours. The choice of a leather beige strap leaves the spotlight for the Snow Star itself. A brilliant stroke of red to the 3 o’clock date counter sharpens its character. The ETA 2892 movement, a watchmaker’s jewel , gives the watch an ultimate sense of nobility . INSPIRED BY THE AURORA BOREALIS The color green refers to the Boreal forests that can be only found in the northern hemisphere of Earth, mainly between latitudes 50° and 60° N. The bright and bold “Boreal Green” dial encapsulates the uniqueness of the green polar lights and makes you feel as the traveler exploring the beauty of Nordic nature. Thanks to its sunray-finish , the Boreal Green dial captures the light, creating a characteristic subtle glow that changes with each movement of the wrist.

watches.name: Archimèdes by Milus - Orange Coral
watches.description: LIMITED EDITION OF 50 PIECES The striking Orange Coral dial attracts attention thanks to its retro 70’s style but remains above all a reliable automatic diver watch, equipped with a discreet helium valve and a bi-directional inner diver bezel. The three hour digits at the cardinal points, 3 o’clock date window, and famous “Broad Arrow” hands coated in SuperLuminova combine seamlessly to bolster readability. Its ETA 2892 movement is protected in a 41mm steel case, resistant up to 30 ATM or 300 meters. The Archimèdes Orange Coral is offered with two easily interchangeable strap options, a smooth 316L brushed stainless steel mesh bracelet and a genuine black Tropic diver rubber strap. A CORAL IN YOUR NAME In line with our beliefs in environmental protection, Milus is partnering with the French NGO Coral Guardian . For every Archimèdes Orange Coral bought, Milus will adopt a coral in your own name. The Coral Guardian team will transplant your coral onto a solid structure in an area where reefs were damaged. This action contributes to the coral reefs restoration. You will receive a personalized adoption certificate with a symbolic photograph, the name of your coral, and its GPS location.

watches.name: LAB 01 - Sky Blue
watches.description: This line reflects the elegance of an active urban lifestyle. Equally minimalistic and sophisticated , LAB 01 seduces onlookers at first glance. The dial made of exposed fiberglass provides a unique texture to every piece. A seemingly simple and refined casing elegantly reveals its polished and brushed finishes, playing with light to reveal its beauty. The hands of LAB 01 are treated with Superluminova, enhancing contrast and improving legibility. The watch is set with a Milanese mesh bracelet . The opening at the bottom of the casing reveals the sun-brushed rotor and housing rings. These fine details are synonymous with the meticulousness of Milus. LAB 01 features an automatic Sellita caliber with 38 hours of power reserve and is enclosed in a waterproof case with a resistance of up to 3 ATM. The model is also fitted with an antireflective sapphire glass.

LAB 01 features an automatic Sellita caliber with 38 hours of power reserve and is enclosed in a waterproof case with a resistance of up to 3 ATM. The model is also fitted with an antireflective sapphire glass.

watches.name: Snow Star - Night Black
watches.description: The robust 904L steel casing gleams with its mirror polished finishing. The sunray brushed black dial traces the path of “Dauphine” hour hands over hand-laid indexes. The elongated case blends seamlessly into harmonious contours. The choice of a leather-lined textile strap leaves the spotlight for the Snow Star itself. A brilliant stroke of red to the 3 o’clock date counter sharpens its character. The ETA 2892 movement, a watchmaker’s jewel , gives the watch an ultimate sense of nobility .

watches.name: Archimèdes by Milus - Deep Blue
watches.description: Archimèdes by Milus is the modern successor to the Milus Super Compressor of the 70s. To create a stunningly contemporary watch , the models’ reinvention was subsequently a question of research and proportions. The development focused on the 41mm brushed casing and the reflection of the mirror-polished bezel. The granulated blue dial, three hour digits at the cardinal points, 3 o’clock date window, rotating bezel and famous “Broad Arrow” hands coated in SuperLuminova combine seamlessly to bolster readability. Its ETA 2892 movement is protected in a steel case equipped with a helium valve, resistant up to 30 ATM or 300 metres.
